verdict.rationale: Exporting account data is a fair question for a SaaS coding-agent platform, but the evidence has no documented full-account export or open-format data portability feature. The 'exportable reports' refer only to usage metrics, and the Sessions API is a developer building block rather than an export capability, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
